adversarially robust models may not transfer better to other domains and the transferability can be improved by regularization.

(1) adversarial training can improve generalization when the sufficient conditions (i.e., the last-layer norm is small and Jacobian norm is large) are satisfied; and (2) data augmentations can improve generalization under the same conditions.
(1) adversarial robustness and domain generalization are correlated, and (2) the sufficient conditions are the norm of last hidden layer and the Jacobian norm.
